Fixed-cell signed traces split into cells with no central edge, with factor [z^3](1+z)prod(1+z^ell+z^{2ell})^{c_ell}, and cells containing exactly one central edge on a fixed arm with subtractive factor -[z^3]c1*z*(1+z)*(1+z+z²)^{c1-1}prod_{ell>=2}(1+z^ell+z^{2ell})^{c_ell}.
